East Asia / Jeju Island, Republic of Korea

Korean traditions / Jeju.

Simbang, seasonal rites and the sea.

PEOPLE & CONTEXT

A place, a name,
a living history.

Jeju's Chilmeoridang Yeongdeunggut is a documented community ritual related to wind, the sea and seasonal livelihoods. UNESCO describes the roles of village ritual specialists and the community, including women divers and ship owners. It is one specific pathway within the diversity of Korean traditions.

SimbangYeongdeunggutSea and seasons
A WAY TO STUDY

Begin with the source.

Follow the account of this named ritual, its place and its participants. Record the calendar and community setting, keeping publicly documented performance distinct from instructions for reproducing the ceremony.
